description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for 'Concept' objects in the OpenMRS system, providing methods to serialize and generate summaries of concept instances.

classes.name: ConceptDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for handling 'Concept' objects, including methods for deserialization from UUID and generating text summaries.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Concept object by fetching it via the ConceptService; returns null if input is blank.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Generates a text summary of a Concept object, primarily returning the concept's name.
